properties.name: letool.cache.enabled
properties.description: Enable the cache starter.

properties.name: letool.cache.redis-prefix
properties.description: Global Redis key prefix for cache data.

properties.name: letool.cache.l1-enabled
properties.description: Global switch for Caffeine L1 cache.

properties.name: letool.cache.l2-enabled
properties.description: Global switch for Redis L2 cache.

properties.name: letool.cache.strong-consistency
properties.description: Deprecated compatibility switch that only maps L1 read validation. It does not enable database durable consistency.

properties.name: letool.cache.consistency.mode
properties.description: Database/cache consistency mode. DURABLE requires Redis, a transaction manager and a CacheInvalidationEventStore.

properties.name: letool.cache.consistency.read-validation
properties.description: Validation performed before returning L1 entries.

properties.name: letool.cache.consistency.write-policy
properties.description: Cache action after a successful database commit.

properties.name: letool.cache.consistency.outbox-table
properties.description: JDBC Outbox table used by DURABLE mode.

properties.name: letool.cache.consistency.fence-ttl
properties.description: Maximum lifetime of a DURABLE Redis write fence.

properties.name: letool.cache.consistency.recovery-interval
properties.description: DURABLE Outbox recovery scan interval.

properties.name: letool.cache.consistency.recovery-batch-size
properties.description: Maximum Outbox events claimed in one recovery scan.

properties.name: letool.cache.consistency.recovery-lease
properties.description: Lease duration for a claimed Outbox event.

properties.name: letool.cache.consistency.retry-base-delay
properties.description: Base delay for exponential Outbox retries.

properties.name: letool.cache.instances.name
properties.description: Cache instance name.

properties.name: letool.cache.instances.l1-enabled
properties.description: Per-cache L1 switch.

properties.name: letool.cache.instances.l1-max-size
properties.description: Maximum Caffeine L1 entries.

properties.name: letool.cache.instances.l1-ttl
properties.description: L1 cache TTL.

properties.name: letool.cache.instances.l2-enabled
properties.description: Per-cache L2 switch.

properties.name: letool.cache.instances.l2-ttl
properties.description: Redis L2 cache TTL.

properties.name: letool.cache.instances.strong-consistency
properties.description: Deprecated per-cache read validation compatibility switch.

properties.name: letool.cache.instances.consistency-mode
properties.description: Optional per-cache database consistency mode override.

properties.name: letool.cache.instances.read-validation
properties.description: Optional per-cache L1 read validation override.

properties.name: letool.cache.instances.write-policy
properties.description: Optional per-cache post-commit write policy override.

properties.name: letool.cache.instances.null-value-cache
properties.description: Cache null loader results to prevent cache penetration.

properties.name: letool.cache.instances.null-value-ttl
properties.description: Null sentinel TTL.

properties.name: letool.cache.invalidation.enabled
properties.description: Enable Redis pub/sub L1 invalidation.

properties.name: letool.cache.invalidation.channel
properties.description: Redis pub/sub channel for L1 invalidation.

properties.name: letool.cache.degradation.recovery-enabled
properties.description: Enable periodic L2 recovery checks.

properties.name: letool.cache.degradation.recovery-interval
properties.description: L2 recovery check interval.

properties.name: letool.cache.monitoring.enabled
properties.description: Enable cache monitoring bean.

properties.name: letool.cache.annotation.enabled
properties.description: Enable annotation-driven cache aspect.
